recipes.title: Crispy Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Juicy spiced beef and melty cheese folded into tortillas and pan-fried until crackly. Dunk them in a zingy cilantro-lime crema.

steps.text: Make the crema: blend the sour cream, cilantro, lime juice, garlic and a pinch of salt until smooth and green. Chill until serving.
Heat a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the beef and onion, break the meat up and cook until browned.
Stir in the garlic, spices, salt, pepper and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute. Pour in the water and simmer until thick and saucy.
Spoon the beef onto one half of each tortilla, top with cheese and fold over.
Wipe the pan, add the oil and heat over medium. Fry the tacos in batches until golden and crispy, about 3 minutes per side.
Serve hot with the crema for dipping and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Hot Honey Crispy Chicken Burger
recipes.description: Shatteringly crispy chicken thighs glazed in sweet-spicy hot honey, stacked with pickles and herby garlic mayo on a toasted brioche bun.

steps.text: Mix the buttermilk and salt in a bowl, add the chicken and marinate for at least 15 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Make the mayo: stir together the mayonnaise, dill, garlic and lemon juice. Chill.
In a wide bowl, mix the flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, pepper and salt.
Heat the oil in a deep, heavy pan to 175°C (350°F). It should be about 3 cm deep.
Lift each thigh out of the buttermilk and press it into the flour mix until fully coated.
Fry 2 thighs at a time, turning once, until deep golden and cooked through (74°C / 165°F inside). Drain on a rack.
Make the hot honey: warm the honey, hot sauce, chili flakes and butter in a small pan until melted and glossy. Brush it all over the chicken.
Toast the buns cut-side down in a dry pan until golden.
Build: mayo on both bun halves, then lettuce, chicken and pickles.

recipes.title: Baked Feta Pasta
recipes.description: A whole block of feta roasted with bursting cherry tomatoes, then stirred into a silky, tangy sauce. The internet favourite, made easy.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F), or 180°C fan.
Put the tomatoes and garlic in a baking dish, set the feta in the middle, drizzle with the oil and sprinkle with oregano, chili flakes, salt and pepper. Toss the tomatoes to coat.
Bake until the tomatoes burst and the feta is soft and golden at the edges.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta in salted water until al dente. Save a mug of pasta water before draining.
Mash the feta and tomatoes together into a creamy sauce. Stir in the pasta, adding splashes of pasta water until silky. Top with basil.

recipes.title: Marry Me Chicken
recipes.description: Golden chicken simmered in a creamy parmesan and sun-dried tomato sauce. Rich, cosy and very proposal-worthy.

steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper, then dust both sides with flour.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken until golden, about 4 minutes per side. Move it to a plate (it finishes cooking later).
Lower the heat to medium. Melt the butter, add the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock and scrape up the browned bits. Add the cream, herbs and chili flakes and simmer.
Stir in the parmesan until melted.
Return the chicken and simmer until cooked through (74°C / 165°F inside). Top with basil.

recipes.title: Smash Burger Tacos
recipes.description: Beef smashed straight onto tortillas and seared until crusty, then topped with cheese, pickles and burger sauce. A burger you can fold.

steps.text: Make the burger sauce: mix the mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, pickle juice and smoked paprika.
Divide the beef into 8 equal balls. Put one on each tortilla and press it out into a thin layer that reaches the edges. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat a large dry pan over high heat. Cook the tacos beef-side down, 2 at a time, until deeply browned and crusty.
Flip, lay a cheese slice on the beef side and cook until the tortilla is crisp and the cheese melts.
Top with lettuce, pickles, onion and burger sauce. Fold and eat right away.

recipes.title: Crispy Rice Salmon Bites
recipes.description: Golden, crunchy rice squares topped with spicy creamy salmon and avocado. Restaurant-style bites, made at home with cooked salmon.

steps.text: Mix the rice with the vinegar, sugar and salt. Press it firmly into a 20 × 20 cm dish lined with baking paper, about 2 cm thick. Chill until firm.
Meanwhile, heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Brush the salmon with soy sauce and bake until it flakes easily.
Flake the salmon and mix it with the mayonnaise and sriracha.
Lift out the rice and cut it into 16 squares. Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and fry the squares until golden and crisp, about 3 minutes per side.
Top each square with salmon, a slice of avocado, green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Gochujang Butter Noodles
recipes.description: Chewy noodles tossed in a glossy, garlicky gochujang butter sauce. Sweet, spicy, buttery and ready in 15 minutes.

steps.text: Cook the noodles according to the package. Save a small cup of the cooking water, then drain.
In the same pot over low heat, melt the butter and cook the garlic until fragrant.
Stir in the gochujang, soy sauce and honey until smooth.
Add the noodles and a splash of the cooking water and toss until glossy and coated.
Top with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Hot Honey Salmon Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Sticky, spicy-sweet glazed salmon over fluffy rice with avocado, cucumber and edamame. A bowl that tastes like a treat.

steps.text: Rinse the rice and cook it with water according to the package, then let it rest covered.
Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Mix the honey, hot sauce, soy sauce and garlic into a glaze.
Put the salmon on a lined tray, rub with the oil and salt, and bake.
Brush the salmon thickly with the glaze and bake until it flakes easily.
Meanwhile, boil the edamame until tender, then drain.
Fill bowls with rice, then salmon, edamame, cucumber and avocado. Spoon over any leftover glaze and top with green onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan Smashed Potatoes
recipes.description: Baby potatoes boiled until tender, smashed flat and roasted until the edges shatter, then finished with garlic and parmesan.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in well-salted water until a knife slides in easily.
Drain and let them steam-dry for a few minutes. Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F), or 200°C fan.
Spread the potatoes on a lined tray and press each one flat with the bottom of a glass.
Mix the oil and garlic and brush it over the potatoes. Season with salt and pepper and roast until golden and crisp.
Sprinkle with parmesan and roast until melted and lacy.
Top with parsley and serve hot.

recipes.title: Oven Doner Kebab Wraps
recipes.description: Spiced meat baked in a tight log and shaved thin like at the kebab shop, wrapped up with crunchy salad and garlic yogurt.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F), or 180°C fan.
Put the meat, grated onion, garlic, spices, salt, pepper and chili flakes in a bowl. Knead firmly until the mixture is sticky and smooth.
Shape it into a tight log on baking paper, roll it up and twist the ends like a candy wrapper. Bake on a tray until cooked through (71°C / 160°F inside).
Meanwhile, stir the yogurt, garlic, lemon juice and a pinch of salt into a sauce.
Rest the meat for 5 minutes, then slice it as thinly as you can. For crispy edges, sear the slices in a hot dry pan.
Warm the wraps, then fill with meat, cabbage, tomato, cucumber, red onion and garlic sauce. Roll up tightly.

recipes.title: Coconut Red Curry Dumpling Bake
recipes.description: Frozen dumplings baked straight in a creamy coconut red curry until golden on top. Almost no prep, all the flavour.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F), or 180°C fan.
Whisk the coconut milk, curry paste, soy sauce and brown sugar in a baking dish. Stir in the spinach.
Arrange the frozen dumplings on top in a single layer.
Bake uncovered until the dumplings are hot all the way through and golden on top.
Squeeze over the lime juice and scatter with green onions.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Bowls
recipes.description: Lemon-garlic chicken over rice with a crunchy Greek salad, feta and homemade tzatziki. Fresh, filling and packed with protein.

steps.text: Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, oil, salt and pepper. Coat the chicken and marinate for at least 20 minutes.
Cook the rice according to the package.
Make the tzatziki: squeeze the grated cucumber dry, then stir it with the yogurt, garlic, dill and lemon juice.
Heat a large pan or grill pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken until golden and cooked through (74°C / 165°F inside), about 6 minutes per side.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes, then slice.
Fill bowls with rice, chicken, cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, olives and feta. Add a big spoon of tzatziki.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Flatbread Wraps
recipes.description: A 2-ingredient high-protein flatbread made from cottage cheese and eggs, baked thin and rolled up with fresh fillings.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F), or 160°C fan, and line a large tray with baking paper.
Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, herbs, garlic powder and salt until completely smooth.
Spread the mixture thinly and evenly over the paper, about 30 × 25 cm.
Bake until golden and dry to the touch.
Cool for 5 minutes, then peel off the paper and cut in half.
Spread each half with hummus, add spinach, tomato, cucumber and feta, then roll up tightly.

recipes.title: Smash Falafel Pita
recipes.description: Herby falafel smashed straight onto pita and fried until crisp, then piled with salad and creamy tahini sauce.

steps.text: Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cilantro, spices, salt, baking powder and flour in a food processor into a coarse, sticky paste.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, water and a pinch of salt until smooth and creamy.
Spread a quarter of the falafel mix over one side of each pita and press it flat.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Fry the pitas falafel-side down until deep golden and crisp.
Flip and toast the other side.
Top with tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, pickles and tahini sauce. Fold and serve.

recipes.title: Pesto Eggs on Toast
recipes.description: Eggs fried in sizzling pesto until crispy-edged and jammy, on toast with smashed avocado. Breakfast in 10 minutes.

steps.text: Toast the bread. Mash the avocado with a pinch of salt and spread it on the toast.
Heat the pesto in a non-stick pan over medium heat until it sizzles.
Crack the eggs into the pesto, cover and cook until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.
Slide the eggs onto the toast and top with tomatoes and chili flakes.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Gnocchi
recipes.description: Pan-fried golden gnocchi in a creamy garlic, spinach and sun-dried tomato sauce. Cosy comfort in 20 minutes.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Fry the gnocchi, stirring now and then, until golden. Move to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium. Melt the butter and cook the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock and cream, add the herbs, salt and pepper and simmer until slightly thickened.
Stir in the parmesan and spinach until the spinach wilts.
Return the gnocchi and toss until coated. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Korean Beef Bowls
recipes.description: Sweet, savoury and gingery ground beef over rice with cucumber and kimchi. A 25-minute weeknight favourite.

steps.text: Cook the rice according to the package.
Mix the soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil and chili flakes into a sauce.
Brown the beef in a large pan over medium-high heat, breaking it up.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant.
Pour in the sauce and simmer until the beef is glossy and the sauce has thickened. Stir in most of the green onions.
Serve over rice with cucumber and kimchi, topped with the rest of the green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Chicken Birria-Style Quesadillas
recipes.description: Tender chicken simmered in a smoky chili broth, tucked into cheesy tortillas, fried crisp and dunked in the rich consommé.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the sliced onion until soft.
Add the garlic and spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, chipotle paste, stock, vinegar, bay leaf, salt and chicken. Cover and simmer until the chicken is very tender.
Lift out the chicken and shred it with two forks. Remove the bay leaf and blend the broth until smooth. This is your consommé.
Dip one side of a tortilla into the consommé and lay it dipped-side down in a hot pan. Cover half with cheese, chicken and cilantro, then fold.
Fry until crisp and the cheese melts, about 2½ minutes per side. Repeat with the rest.
Serve with cups of hot consommé for dipping, chopped onion and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Protein Baked Oats
recipes.description: Blended oats baked into a soft, cake-like breakfast with bursting blueberries and a protein boost.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F), or 160°C fan.
Blend the oats, protein powder, banana, egg, milk, baking powder and cinnamon until smooth.
Pour into 2 small oven dishes and scatter the blueberries on top.
Bake until risen and set in the middle.
Cool for 3 minutes before eating.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Steak Bites
recipes.description: Juicy cubes of steak seared hard in a screaming-hot pan and tossed in sizzling garlic butter. Ready in 20 minutes.

steps.text: Pat the steak dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large pan over high heat until smoking. Sear the steak in 2 batches in a single layer, turning once, until browned outside and pink inside.
Lower the heat to medium. Melt the butter with the garlic and chili flakes.
Return all the steak and toss in the garlic butter for 30 seconds. Sprinkle with parsley.
